name: Configure Scene via Protocol
goal: Load and configure a 3D scene in CoreGFX renderer
postconditions: Cryo Studio has confirmation of success

mainFlow.action: Cryo Studio creates SceneConfig message with scene URI and parameters
Message is sent via cryo.scene protocol channel
Scene configuration is applied (lighting, camera defaults, etc.)
Success response sent back to Cryo Studio

steps.action: SceneConfig contains invalid or inaccessible scene URI
Error response with details sent to Cryo Studio

exceptions.name: Connection Lost
exceptions.handling: Queue pending configs, retry on reconnect

exceptions.name: Out of Memory
exceptions.handling: Return error with memory status, suggest smaller scene
